evidence_citations.excerpt: Zone 3 (Drain adjacent to Yogurt Filling Line B) returned POSITIVE for Listeria species. ... Re-swabbing conducted on Feb 16, 2026. Result: PENDING FROM LAB.
evidence_citations.finding_reason: A positive Listeria pathogen result was identified on February 14, 2026, but the corrective action re-swab result is marked as "PENDING" in records from April 2026. This indicates an open, unresolved high-risk biological finding with inadequate record coverage and incomplete corrective actions. (Human verified: Verified onsite)

clause_mappings.requirement: The pest prevention program shall be documented, detailing bait mapping, chemical safety data sheets, applicator licensing, and inspection frequencies. Methods shall be effective in protecting food products from contamination.

clause_mappings.requirement: Water and steam used in food processing must comply with local potability standards. Water safety must be verified at least annually through analytical laboratory microbiological and chemical testing.
clause_mappings.findingReason: No water potability test records, municipal water reports, or backflow preventer inspection certificates were found among the uploaded documents. Under SQF 11.3.1, annual laboratory testing is a mandatory compliance requirement and cannot be verified without documentary proof. (Human verified: Verified onsite)

clause_mappings.requirement: An environmental monitoring program (EMP) shall be implemented for high-risk processing zones to monitor for pathogen presence. The program must specify sampling plans, corrective actions for positives, and continuous verification.
